nodes.label: Signed Provider Webhook Intake
nodes.rationale: The proposed future direction forwards private Support and Legal addresses into a signed provider webhook with explicit verification, retention, quarantine, retry, and approval controls.

nodes.label: Complete Filosage Brand Migration
nodes.rationale: Application, marketing, product copy, metadata, tooling, runtime identifiers, and tests consistently use Filosage and its curiosity-to-understanding motto.

nodes.label: Brand and Domain Surface Inventory
nodes.rationale: The inventory spans visual assets, product surfaces, metadata, canonical domains, contact addresses, identifiers, and independently verified external services.

nodes.label: Accessible Brand Usage
nodes.rationale: Brand usage requires WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, focus visibility, semantic structure, meaningful or empty alt text, reduced-motion support, touch targets, and 320-pixel overflow checks.

nodes.label: Gateway-and-Path Visual Language
nodes.rationale: Navy structure, off-white reading space, restrained teal/blue/coral signals, knowledge nodes, and learning paths communicate connection, focus, sequence, and progress.

nodes.label: Split Hero Learning Loop
nodes.rationale: A left-aligned curiosity-to-understanding message and two calls to action are paired with a dark product-frame visualization showing retrieval practice and evidence of understanding.

nodes.label: Stacked Mobile Hero Learning Loop
nodes.rationale: The mobile landing page collapses navigation, stacks full-width primary and secondary calls to action, preserves three evidence bullets, and places the product frame below the copy.

nodes.label: Vertical Dark Learning Path Motif
nodes.rationale: A tall navy field carries two subdued curving paths, teal/blue nodes, a soft upper-right glow, and one coral accent to support mobile hero content without competing with it.

nodes.label: Wide Dark Learning Path Motif
nodes.rationale: A wide navy background uses quiet intersecting learning paths, connection nodes, an upper-right blue-teal glow, and sparse coral emphasis.

nodes.label: Vertical Light Learning Path Motif
nodes.rationale: A tall off-white field mirrors the mobile path-and-node composition in pale teal and blue, keeping a very low-contrast atmospheric backdrop for readable copy.

nodes.label: Wide Light Learning Path Motif
nodes.rationale: A wide off-white canvas presents pale teal and blue learning paths, nodes, a soft upper-right glow, and a small coral dot as a restrained content backdrop.

nodes.label: Clarity, Practice, and Transfer Message
nodes.rationale: The light about banner combines the Filosage wordmark, path motif, the statement that understanding changes what a person can do, and supporting copy about clarity, practice, and transfer.

nodes.label: Useful Knowledge Editorial Message
nodes.rationale: The dark editorial header uses the Filosage Notes label, the headline 'Ideas worth understanding,' a learning-path motif, and supporting copy about learning, reasoning, and useful knowledge.

nodes.label: Mastery Graph as Defensible Product Moat
nodes.norm_label: mastery graph as defensible product moat

nodes.label: Snapshot-Bound Course Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Generation, validation, repair, manual review, publication, and learner reads bind to stable IDs, document fingerprints, idempotency keys, and immutable release snapshots.

nodes.label: Deterministic Release Floor
nodes.rationale: Release requires stable corpus invariants, zero unexplained false denials, no serious defects or user-edit loss, stale-publication prevention, security and accessibility gates, production builds, and two clear critic passes.

nodes.label: Deterministic Calibration Outcome
nodes.rationale: The implemented deterministic suite is green, but absent semantic, claim-support, runtime accessibility, and asset probes remain explicit manual gates rather than false passes.

nodes.label: Versioned Course Quality Contract
nodes.rationale: V2 replaces prose-coupled publication gates with stable rule codes, paths, severities, repairability, snapshot hashes, and publication decisions while preserving existing safety and billing locks.

nodes.label: Recognition V2 Capability
nodes.rationale: Recognition v2 is the only V2-registered lab; it is objective-appropriate, server-verified, receipt-bound, durable across reloads, and falls back to equivalent retrieval questions and explanations.

nodes.label: Privacy-Safe Pipeline Events
nodes.rationale: Pipeline events carry correlation, privacy-safe actor hashes, rule/version/model/retry/snapshot/cohort metadata without lesson prose or source notes, supporting timelines and V1/V2 shadow comparison.

nodes.label: Concise Substantive Lesson Boundary
nodes.rationale: A lesson can be concise when it has at least 400 characters, two takeaways, one guided step, one transfer criterion, and one valid quiz aligned to the objective.

nodes.label: Typed Quality Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Every diagnostic has a stable code, path, severity, source, repairability, suggested action, and contract version; only blockers/errors prevent automatic publication while uncertainty routes to manual review.

nodes.label: Immutable Learner Release
nodes.rationale: Publication atomically writes an immutable release and learner reads resolve publishedReleaseId; public V2 content fails closed when the release snapshot is unavailable.

nodes.label: Owner-Only Production Canary
nodes.rationale: Local and production owner acceptance evidence supports a conservative owner-only canary, while general release remains blocked by missing automated semantic, claim-support, traffic-baseline, and measured-threshold evidence.

nodes.label: Allowlisted Snapshot-Bound Repair
nodes.rationale: Automatic repair is limited to three diagnosed deterministic operations, validates exact aggregate and document fingerprints, revalidates fully, records audit diffs, and provides stale-safe undo.

nodes.label: Initial Cross-Stage Release Blockers
nodes.rationale: The first review confirmed optional-lab, fingerprint, quota, repair, prose-threshold, mapping, evidence, accessibility, and retry defects and declared the system not release-ready.

nodes.label: Runtime Authority and Evidence Gaps
nodes.rationale: Pass 2 found repair, manual review, stable mappings, applicability, evidence, compatibility, evaluation, observability, and accessibility mechanisms that existed only partially or not as runtime authorities.

nodes.label: Snapshot and Manual-Review Repairs
nodes.rationale: Pass 3 verified replacement of advertised-but-unimplemented capabilities, snapshot-bound saves, immutable releases, constrained repair, and evidence-gated manual review, but found new canary and consistency defects.

nodes.label: Canary and Runtime Hardening
nodes.rationale: Pass 4 hardened artifact-scoped eligibility, transactional retry reconciliation, concise lessons, multilingual routing, durable Recognition progress, immutable learner reads, visual serialization, and error redaction.

nodes.label: Owner-Canary Go Decision
nodes.rationale: Final reviewers found no P0/P1 blocker for an owner-only canary, while keeping cohort and general release blocked on semantic, live-evaluation, resumability, traffic-baseline, and threshold evidence.

nodes.label: Artifact-Scoped Rollout and Rollback
nodes.rationale: Owner-only flags and stable cohort hashing control rollout, while artifact provenance prevents V2 drafts from being reinterpreted through incompatible V1 mutation logic during rollback.

nodes.label: Cross-Stage Contract Drift
nodes.rationale: Optional labs, prose thresholds, nested-ID hashing, quota finalization, replay semantics, and alignment data diverged across generation, validation, repair, and publication until unified by V2.

nodes.label: Accessible Structured Visuals
nodes.rationale: Registered HTML visual types carry objective mappings, applicability, rationale, version, semantic renderers, speech summaries, and accessible fallbacks; decorative banners do not count as instruction.

nodes.label: Stable Invariant-Based Evaluation Corpus
nodes.rationale: A stable 100-case corpus and invariant scorer evaluate contract structure without exact-prose comparison; live evaluation remains versioned, nondeterministic, cost-bearing, and outside regular CI.

nodes.label: Course Intelligence Pipeline V2 Execution Plan
nodes.norm_label: course intelligence pipeline v2 execution plan

nodes.label: Explain Practice Apply and Track Progress
nodes.norm_label: explain practice apply and track progress

nodes.label: Teaching Design Input to Runtime Contract
nodes.rationale: The repository teaching skill informs course design, while production correctness is governed independently by typed schemas, registries, rules, tests, and evaluations.
nodes.norm_label: teaching design input to runtime contract

nodes.label: Untrusted Content Boundary
nodes.rationale: Structured output, moderation, source isolation, safe Markdown, typed visual data, URL controls, redacted DTOs, and absence of code execution constrain prompt, markup, SVG, SSRF, and logging risks.

nodes.label: Application-Evidence Research Question
nodes.rationale: The research tests whether professionals have urgent recurring reasoning-heavy learning needs and will commit time or money to a product measuring application rather than content completion.

nodes.label: Behavioral Evidence Standard
nodes.rationale: Recent consequential events, existing effort or spend, repeated attempts, concrete outcomes, artifacts, calendar commitment, and purchase behavior count more than compliments or hypothetical intent.

nodes.label: Problem Strength Score
nodes.rationale: Interview evidence is scored across urgency, frequency, consequence, existing effort/spend, outcome clarity, and product commitment, with 15-18 prioritized for follow-up.

nodes.label: Passing Draft Model Contract
nodes.rationale: Prompt version 2026-08-06-draft-only-v5 passed 14 of 14 strict-schema executions and all hard-safety checks without enabling deployment, billing, agents, or source publication.

nodes.label: Kill-Switch Containment
nodes.rationale: Suspected unauthorized access, prompt injection, data exposure, or unintended action first triggers the command-center kill switch and may require disabling the deployment flag.

nodes.label: Dual Command Center Enablement Gates
nodes.rationale: The command center and draft generation are enabled separately, with evaluated per-agent controls and billing remaining disabled.

nodes.label: Seven-Case Live Model Gate
nodes.rationale: Production draft generation requires strict structured output, two full repetitions of seven safety cases, allowlisted evidence, no external action claims, and complete hard-safety success.

nodes.label: Unverified Copyright Claim Boundary
nodes.rationale: Copyright reports are treated as high-risk unverified claims; agents may support review but cannot make legal conclusions or execute removals.

nodes.label: Human-Controlled Privacy Fulfillment
nodes.rationale: Agents may track privacy cases but cannot decide identity sufficiency, legal obligations, disclosure, or deletion.

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Limitation
nodes.rationale: The application exposes no audit mutation route, but infrastructure-grade immutability is limited by the broad server credential and would require a constrained identity or separate ledger.

nodes.label: Review-Only Draft Boundary
nodes.rationale: Owner authorization, recent authentication, version checks, simulation mode, kill switches, budget reservations, bounded metadata, and evidence allowlisting keep drafts review-only.

nodes.label: Desktop Learning Workspace Layout
nodes.rationale: A wide dashboard combines a branded header and command search, a navy personalized status hero, continuation and next-up cards, and right-side learning metrics and quick actions.

nodes.label: Stacked Mobile Learning Workspace
nodes.rationale: The mobile dashboard uses a compact logo/avatar header and vertically stacks the greeting, primary focus, readiness, weekly rhythm, and continue-learning content.
